ErrorKind.description: What kind of failure happened. Clients branch on this, never on messages.

oneOf.description: The request was malformed or a value was out of range.
The request conflicts with the current state, such as a stale revision.
Something needed (the daemon, a provider, the network) can't be reached.
A model provider returned an error.

description: The `data` of every error reply: clients branch on `kind`, never on the message. `x-codes` gives the JSON-RPC code of each kind.

detail.description: Technical detail for logs and the "Details" view; never shown by default.

retryable.description: True when the same request may succeed if sent again later.

user_message.description: One plain sentence that can be shown to the user as is.

title: Errors
